# R51 — Staging restructuring brief

Owner instruction: complete website restructuring master task, received **18 November 2026**. Implementation resumed **19 November 2026**. Branch: `phase1/customer-journey-repairs`; audited baseline: `b2b8946882929da4ce7e0e01de4ba1511eed818a`. This task does not authorize main or production changes.

## Audit, sources and scope

The required audit was delivered before implementation in [R51_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md](../../docs/R51_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md). The existing static JSON/Python/template architecture remains appropriate. Generated HTML/browser modules are rebuilt from sources. No framework, database, paid CMS, subscription or destructive rename migration is needed.

Read the root AGENTS, the current five-document reference and manifest, [SEO_PRESERVATION.md](SEO_PRESERVATION.md), actual service/policy/FAQ/pricing sources, effective collection/project/Shop publication gates and existing forms/builders. Original named company handbooks remain unavailable and are not treated as reviewed.

Latest applicable rules are R51-01 through R51-12 in the current master. Earlier unsuperseded commercial conditions remain authoritative, including separate service eligibility, payment obligations, benefits and existing agreed quotations. Men's ordinary Tier 3 internal prices were verified directly as 300,000/400,000 RWF under the 12 November approval. Hiding public prices does not revoke or rewrite that record.

## Page purposes and customer journeys

- Homepage: add two curated approved fashion cards and one larger feature below the header; preserve existing content and service actions beneath.
- `/showroom/`: one primary browse/search/filter interface for currently eligible clothing media. Filters use actual published audience/type/style/classification data. Original filenames are visible and searchable. Empty categories stay absent.
- Existing men's/women's/category/detail routes: retain destinations, metadata and exact photo/design identity for SEO, old links and saved quotations. New primary navigation can open filtered Showroom views. Do not delete or silently redirect valuable routes.
- Custom Tailoring and other services: keep relevant service information and quotation actions. Replace public service tariffs with quotation guidance; shared conditions are linked to existing FAQs/policies without removing service-specific exceptions.
- Existing Selected Designs → fabric/advice/own fabric → quotation → review → explicit submission remains. Every photograph, identity and quantity must survive; no duplicate provider/form/upload system. Showroom joins the permitted browsing area without changing ordinary expiry or separate Express recovery.
- FAQ: preserve interface, search, cards, anchors and synchronized structured data. Customer-friendly shared explanations use authoritative scoped facts; do not duplicate the entire Terms document.
- Terms: stable `/terms-and-conditions/` and existing anchors remain. No approved PDF exists. Prepare the publication-gated viewer/registry and retain readable current online Terms as the transitional fallback. A real approved, reconciled active PDF replaces the full fallback rather than adding a competing full document.
- Shop: preserve existing records, product price renderer and publication/stock/checkout gates. The audited 26 enquiry-only displays are not verified sale stock; no new direct-purchase approval is inferred.

## Media, policies and fact ownership

The audited effective public media set contains 28 photographs: 21 Reference Design and seven Our Work photos associated with five approved projects. Raw collection published flags are not sufficient permission. The inventory contains 402 image files and seven MP4s; no per-video publication approval was found. Recoverability and duplicate hashes do not authorize publishing or deleting files.

Use one source for each fact, with projections for shared components, public service wording and generated backend constants. Public prices, fixed fees and service surcharge cost percentages are hidden in the staged quotation-first presentation. Payment/deposit obligations and approved benefit eligibility remain. The surcharge-percentage clarification received no answer before work resumed; hiding those public cost rates is an implementation interpretation of the broad pricing instruction, not a changed internal rate. Owner staging review may refine it.

Document publication requires a real PDF, immutable version identity, checksum, approval/effective metadata and recorded human reconciliation against operational sources. Unapproved PDFs stay outside the deployed/public repository. There is no browser upload/CMS. Do not extract a PDF and automatically treat inferred clauses as approved FAQ facts.

| Action | Destination / expected behavior | Safeguard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Header/footer Showroom | `/showroom/` | Ordinary HTML link; shared rendering and mobile navigation retained |
| Men's/women's showcase | Filtered Showroom | Uses eligible curated media, no inventory promise |
| Showroom photograph | Existing exact design detail URL and photo context | Original allowlisted photograph and design identity retained |
| Existing Select This Design | Existing shared selection/review flow | No new cart/form; quantities and lifetime rules retained |
| Quotation action | Existing Custom Tailoring/request route | Review and required Terms/Privacy consent; no accepted order promise |
| Showroom Shop association | Existing eligible listing only | No new stock, price or sale entitlement |
| Approved document open/download | Actual current approved version PDF only | No fake link while current document is absent |
| Terms legacy anchor | Stable Terms route and anchor | No invented PDF page mapping |

Preserve official contact sources, manual WhatsApp consent/Send, conditional address/measurement fields, duplicate/error handling and positive-provider-only acknowledgement. Local mocked submissions do not prove staff inbox receipt, production acceptance or payment.

## Validation and publication boundary

Run the actual final build/check commands and the new source/media/document/public-pricing invariants, then applicable existing backend, selection, quotation, SEO/sitemap/link and mobile/accessibility tests. Use temporary approved/unapproved fixtures for publication tests; never deploy fixtures or send real customer enquiries/messages.

The exact final source map and owner procedures are in [WEBSITE_SOURCE_MAP.md](../../docs/WEBSITE_SOURCE_MAP.md). Reports must list real PASS/FAIL/NOT TESTED outcomes, changed files, pending official PDF/video/stock information and actual staging SHA/provider URL. Execution-proxy restrictions must be distinguished from origin failures and actual rendered verification. No production deployment or destructive migration is authorized.
